name: Riku Mina
source:
A girl with a relatively clear background.
Handles all keyboard instruments.
Possess a brilliant technique by pursuing her own convenience settings.
Can play the role of Boke and Tsukkomi, but both are weak.
Play and listen to any kind of music.
When we notice it, she is eating a baked snack or something.
Special skills include cooking, piano, rope jumping, and dancing.
Has the ability to recall about 80 percent of the new modern [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waka_(poetry)]Waka poems[/url].
Seems to have a special interest in [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saigy%C5%8D]Saigyou[/url]'s poet.
Loves [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fr%C3%A9d%C3%A9ric_Chopin]Frederic Chopin[/url] and [url=/c92357]Tsuda Jun[/url]'s music.

[Translated from the [url=http://wosakana.com/wosakana_soft/game/htv.html]official site[/url]]
